hooks.command: b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$b" = "main" ] || [ "$b" = "master" ]; then printf "%s" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Never commit to main. Every change in this repository goes on a branch named type/TB-XXXX-slug and lands through a pull request. See docs/ways-of-working/branching-and-review.md"}}'; fi

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in */mainframe/*|*/legacy/*|*/integration/*) case "${f##*/}" in pom.xml|build.gradle|build.gradle.kts|gradle.properties) printf "%s" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This is a build manifest in a deliberately pinned legacy stratum (Java 8 / Spring Boot 2.7.18 / Tomcat 8.5). Those versions are load-bearing: they reproduce the version lock real banks live under, and upgrading them destroys the purpose of this repository. A version change here requires an explicit instruction from the repository owner AND an ADR - see CLAUDE.md and docs/governance/adr/0002-deliberate-legacy-strata.md. Confirm this is intended."}}'; esac;; esac
